summary.plain: The HAWC water-Cherenkov gamma-ray observatory of 300 tanks on the Sierra Negra volcano, Puebla, Mexico.
summary.technical: One local map for facility:sierra-negra. Drawn as a single reference point at the array's own published coordinate (18.99N, 97.31W), tighter than the existing site record's Nominatim peak-geocode point; the 300-tank footprint has no sourced overall outline shape this session.
